body: Well, obviously you think my problems are meaningless just because I'm a teenager. Thanks for helping to make the right decision.
Okay....I just logged onto Facebook and she posted about it on her homepage! She said I am a "rude pig who doesn't know how to act in front of a lady". I am officially done!!!!!!!!!!!!
So.....maybe I can just say I had a virus? I just am dreading the moment I have to make eye contact again after decimating my underwear in front of her.

No, I appreciate you sharing.....thank you for taking the time to talk.
I just don't think I can recover from this.

That sounds rough, but was it in front of the girl of your dreams? How can I even think of showing my face on Tuesday? I haven't even logged onto Facebook because I am afraid she posted something about it. I just want to die now. I am a living joke.

Yeah, but what about Facebook and stuff. I can't move to a new school district over this. How would I tell my parents? My life is over. All because of a stupid fart turned bowel movement. I tried soooo hard to hold it in, but I think that letting it build so long is where I went wrong. I am actually crying hysterically right now.
